subject.title: Auto-compaction during ongoing turn silently abandons task execution without resumption

question: What recovery contract should OpenClaw guarantee when threshold or overflow compaction interrupts a user-facing turn that has already used tools?
rationale: The source and reports show several plausible fixes, but choosing between delaying compaction, automatic continuation, delivery-context replay, and visible failure affects side-effect safety and user-facing channel semantics.

options.title: Adopt reply-obligation recovery
options.body: Track pending user-facing turns through compaction and resume only from replay-safe boundaries while preserving the original delivery target or surfacing a visible failure.

options.title: Delay threshold compaction
options.body: Allow overflow recovery to retry, but defer ordinary threshold compaction until the current turn reaches terminal delivery or a bounded timeout.

options.title: Visibility-only for now
options.body: Keep automatic resume narrow and instead make compaction interruption visibly fail so users can retry without silent abandonment.

recommendation.title: Adopt reply-obligation recovery
recommendation.body: Track pending user-facing turns through compaction and resume only from replay-safe boundaries while preserving the original delivery target or surfacing a visible failure.
